node.n1_safehouse.title: Indawo Yokucasha (Igumbi 404)
node.n1_safehouse.desc: Ifulethi elimnyama elisesitezi sesithathu ngaphezu kwendawo yokuhlanza izingubo evula ubusuku nemini. Izibani ze-neon ezicwayizayo, amadokhethi ephepha, kanye nejeneretha yesimo esiphuthumayo.
node.n2_taxi_rank.title: Isiteshi Samatekisi sase-Queen Street
node.n2_taxi_rank.desc: Inxakanxaka enkulu yamaToyota Quantums amile, amajeneretha adumayo, nephunga leshisanyama elosiwe.
node.n3_central_precinct.title: Isiteshi Samaphoyisa sase-Durban Central
node.n3_central_precinct.desc: Amaphasishi agcwele izibani ze-fluorescent ezicwayizayo, amagumbi okuboshwa akhiyiwe, kanye nendawo yokulawula ye-TRT kaBrigadier Mokoena.
node.n4_city_hall.title: Ihhovisi Lamathanda eHholo Ledolobha
node.n4_city_hall.desc: Izinsika zamamabula ezifihla izinkokhelo ezingemuva, izinkontileka zokuphepha ezingekho, kanye namamemo amathanda adabuliwe.
node.n5_cyber_pawn.title: I-Cyber-Pawn yase-Point Road
node.n5_cyber_pawn.desc: Ikhawunta ekhanyiswe i-neon ethengisa ama-SIMs abashisiwe akopishiwe, ama-decoder omsakazo wamasosha, kanye nezinsimbi ezingalandeleki.
node.n6_pier2_port.title: Itheminali Yeziqukathi yase-Pier 2
node.n6_pier2_port.desc: Ama-crane aphakeme agqamile enkungwini yasolwandle. I-Berth 14 iphatha amathenki ezinto zokwakha amakhemikhali angabhalisiwe.
node.n7_archive_basement.title: Isitezi Esingaphansi Kwesakhiwo Esidala Samagugu Kamasipala
node.n7_archive_basement.desc: Amagumbi angaphansi komhlaba agcwele amanzi agcine amashumi eminyaka amarekhodi kamasipala ephepha kanye nokuvuza kolwazi lwe-Hawks.
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.title: Ama-Penthouses ase-Ridge
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.desc: Imibhoshongo yengilazi nensimbi ebheke olwandle lwase-Indian. Iqashwe amaqembu akhethekile azimele anama-akhawunti aphesheya kwezilwandle.
node.n9_township_depot.title: Indawo Yokugcina Impahla Yasenyakatho Yetownship
node.n9_township_depot.desc: Amagumbi okugcina impahla ensimbi ecwebezelayo anamathenki amanzi kamasipala agqekeziwe, izixhumi zikagesi ezingekho emthethweni, kanye nabaqaphi abahlomile kakhulu.
node.n10_high_court.title: Amagumbi Enkantolo Ephakeme yase-Durban
node.n10_high_court.desc: Izindawo zokuhlola ukuphepha zokhuni nensimbi zasenkantolo yobukoloni lapho kuxoxwa khona ngama-subpoenas ngokumelene nama-syndicate ezidakamizwa.
node.n11_citrus_estate.title: Ifama Lamawolintshi E-Hydroponic
node.n11_citrus_estate.desc: Indawo yezolimo eqinisiwe efihla ama-reactor amakhemikhali angaphansi komhlaba kanye nezindawo zokugcina izinto zokwakha.
node.n12_cargo_apron.title: Indawo Yokulayisha Impahla yase-King Shaka
node.n12_cargo_apron.desc: I-tarmac ye-Hangar 7 lapho amajethi azimele e-Gulfstream kanye nezimoto ezinkulu zokuthutha impahla zidlula amasiko aseNingizimu Afrika.

msg.unused_dice_warning: Usenamadayisi esenzo angasetshenziswanga namuhla. Ukulala manje kuzowalahla.
msg.nightfall_summary: Ukuhwalala kuzoqhubekisela phambili amawashi osongo futhi kushintshe izigaba ze-Eskom Load Shedding.
msg.next_day_forecast: Iqoqo lamadayisi akusasa libalwa ngokusekelwe Ekuzoleni kwakho.
slot.act_audit_docket.title: Hlola i-Docket #409
slot.act_audit_docket.desc: Qhathanisa ama-invoice amachashaza egazi ethenka ne-registry kamasipala.
slot.act_audit_docket.clean: Ulandelela izinkokhelo uze ufike kwa-Zululand Aqua-Logistics nase-Berth 14.
slot.act_audit_docket.compromised: Amahora wokucindezela amehlo ngaphansi kwesibani esicwayizayo akhiphe igama elilodwa lenkampani eyimbumbulu.
slot.act_audit_docket.failure: Amakhodi e-ledger ayisiphithiphithi esingapheli. Ikhanda lakho liyashaya.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.title: Phumula Uphinde Utholise u-Nandi
slot.act_rest_safehouse.desc: Buyisela amandla. Thenga amabhandeshi ukuze ubambezele ukopha kuka-Nandi.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.clean: Uhlanzela amabhandeshi akhe bese uphumula. Umkhuhlane ka-Nandi wehlile kancane.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.compromised: Ukuphumula kuphazanyiswe yizinhlabo zamaphoyisa ezivela e-Queen Street.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.failure: Ubuthongo obungaphumuli obugcwele amaphupho amabi ngamabutho e-TRT ka-Mokoena.
slot.act_call_maharaj.title: Shayela u-Dr. Maharaj (Udokotela Ongabhalisiwe)
slot.act_call_maharaj.desc: Letha udokotela ozimele ukuze akhiphe inhlamvu futhi azinzise u-Nandi.
slot.act_call_maharaj.clean: U-Dr. Maharaj ukhiphe inhlamvu ngobunono. U-Nandi akasasezingozini.
slot.act_call_maharaj.compromised: Ukuhlinza kube nzima ngaphansi kwesibani, kodwa isimo sika-Nandi sesizinzile.
slot.act_call_maharaj.failure: U-Dr. Maharaj wethuswe yimoto yamaphoyisa ngaphandle, ushiye imithi elwa namagciwane kuphela.
slot.act_rank_muscle.title: Phoqelela Izintela Zomzila
slot.act_rank_muscle.desc: Sikiza abashayeli abangemthetho emzileni wase-Umgeni ngenxa ka-Bra Bheki.
slot.act_rank_muscle.clean: Abashayeli abangemthetho bakhokhe ngaphandle kokukhipha izikhali. U-Bra Bheki ukhombisa inhlonipho.
slot.act_rank_muscle.compromised: Uthole ishifti ehlombe ngesikhathi sokulwa, kodwa uhambe nemali.
slot.act_rank_muscle.failure: Kudutshuliwe eduze kweranki. Amaphoyisa kamasipala akhala ngezinhlabo kude.
slot.act_taxi_intel.title: Sebenzisa Inethiwekhi Yamatekisi
slot.act_taxi_intel.desc: Khokhela o-marshal beranki ukuze balandelele ama-bakkie e-TRT angamakiwe nezindawo zokumisa.
slot.act_taxi_intel.clean: Abashayeli bamatekisi bagcwalise imisakazo ngemizila eqondile yamaphoyisa ka-Mokoena.
slot.act_taxi_intel.compromised: Ulwazi oluncane oluvela kubashayeli ababone ingxenye yomkhankaso kuphela.
slot.act_taxi_intel.failure: Ukhokhele ulwazi oluyinhlebo nje yasezindlini zotshwala.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.title: Fumbathisa u-Clerk Wobufakazi
slot.act_bribe_clerk.desc: Faka imali esandleni sephoyisa elikhohlakele ukuze uthole imibiko yezinhlamvu yokuphanga kwe-N2.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.clean: U-clerk ushelelisise amafayela obufakazi etafuleni lase-canteen.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.compromised: Uthole izingxenye zemibiko ngaphambi kokuba abezangaphakathi badlule.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.failure: U-clerk uthathe imali yakho wabe esekubika ku-sergeant ka-Mokoena.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.title: Ngena E-Ofisini lika-Mokoena
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.desc: Qamba amanga kumphathi wakho wakudala ukuthi kungani u-Nandi esohlwini lwe-BOLO.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.clean: U-Mokoena ukholwe yindaba yakho, wabe ekunika u-R3,000 ukuze umlethele i-Docket #409.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.compromised: U-Mokoena ukubhekile ngamehlo abukhali ngaphesheya kwedeski lakhe. Uzithengele amahora angama-24.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.failure: U-Mokoena uzwe iphunga lokukhwabanisa. Amaphoyisa e-TRT akukhiphele ngaphandle ngesibhamu.
slot.act_audit_tenders.title: Ngena E-Registry Kamasipala
slot.act_audit_tenders.desc: Zenze isikhulu sokuhlolwa ukuze ulandelele ama-akhawunti ka-Zululand Aqua-Logistics.
slot.act_audit_tenders.clean: Uthole amakhophi asayiniwe ohlelo lokukhwabanisa lwe-Ma-Sibi.
slot.act_audit_tenders.compromised: Ezokuphepha zicishe zakubamba, kodwa uphume namarisidi abalulekile.
slot.act_audit_tenders.failure: Ama-alamu akhale esitezi sesine. Ubaleke ungenalutho.
slot.act_masibi_deal.title: Phakamisa Isivumelwano Esikhulwini sika-Ma-Sibi
slot.act_masibi_deal.desc: Nikela ngokufihla i-ledger yomhloli ngaphambi kokuvota kukamasipala ukuze uthole ukuvikelwa kwe-City Hall.
slot.act_masibi_deal.clean: Isikhulu sika-Ma-Sibi sikunike u-R5,000 wemali yokuthula nokufinyelela egumbini lokulawula ugesi.
slot.act_masibi_deal.compromised: Isikhulu sivumelene ngesivumelwano sesikhashana, sivula ukufinyelela kugridi kamasipala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.failure: Onogada baka-Mayor bakukhiphele ngaphandle futhi bazise isiteshi samaphoyisa.
slot.act_crack_phone.title: Qhekeza Ifoni Yomhloli
slot.act_crack_phone.desc: Dlula ukuvikelwa kwe-biometric ocingweni lomhloli oshonile.
slot.act_crack_phone.clean: U-Sparks uqhekeze ukuvikelwa. Imilayezo yezwi evela e-Pier 2 isiyadawunilodeka.
slot.act_crack_phone.compromised: Ezokuphepha zithumele isexwayiso sokusula idatha, kodwa u-Sparks ubambe i-firewall.
slot.act_crack_phone.failure: I-ping yezokuphepha yazise abahlanzi be-cyber ngaphambi kokuba u-Sparks akhiphe ikhebula.
slot.act_clone_transponder.title: Kopisha ama-frequency omsakazo we-SAPS
slot.act_clone_transponder.desc: Yakha isithwebuli sokunqamula imiyalezo ukuze uqaphele imiyalo ye-TRT futhi weqe izindawo zokuhlola ze-SAPS.
slot.act_clone_transponder.clean: Ufake esikhwameni isithwebuli se-SAPS esikopishiwe—manje usungakwazi ukuzwa futhi weqe zonke izindawo zokuhlola ngesikhathi sangempela.
slot.act_clone_transponder.compromised: Isithwebuli somsakazo esinomsindo omningi sisebenza ngokwanele ukukusiza unyonyobe udlule emaphoyiseni.
slot.act_clone_transponder.failure: Ushise ibhodi lokushisela (soldering board) futhi ulahlekelwe u-R500 ezingxenyeni ezisele.
slot.act_recon_berth14.title: Ukuhlola ukuthululwa kwempahla e-Berth 14
slot.act_recon_berth14.desc: Thatha izithombe zamagubu amakhemikhali alayishwa emalolini kamasipala.
slot.act_recon_berth14.clean: Izithombe ezicacile zika-Mokoena exhawula umphathi wamachweba ka-Zuko.
slot.act_recon_berth14.compromised: Onogada basechwebeni babone ukukhanya kwethoshi lakho; ubalekela phakathi kweziqukathi.
slot.act_recon_berth14.failure: Izigebengu zekhatheli zikubambe ekhoneni ngemuva kwe-forklift; uphume ngomgodi ngomkhuhlane.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.title: [ISIPHETHO] Bhekana ne-convoy yase-Berth 14
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.desc: Sondela ekuthululweni kwempahla phakathi kwamabili ukuze wenze ukuqamekela kwakho noma uxoxisane ngesivumelwano sika-Kingpin e-The Glass House.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.clean: Uthatha isikhundla sakho ngenhla kwe-Berth 14 njengoba amaloli amanzi kamasipala esondela kwi-crane ka-Zuko.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.compromi: Unyonyobe wadlula ocingweni phansi kwemvula enkulu njengoba izinjini ze-convoy ziqala ukuduma.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.failure: Izinja zokuphepha echwebeni zikuphoqe ukuba ubuyele emuva; isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwempahla sesiphela.
slot.act_handover_dockets.title: Nikeza u-Colonel van der Merwe imininingwane
slot.act_handover_dockets.desc: Nikeza amakhophi aqinisekisiwe e-Docket #409 kubaphenyi abathembekile base-Hawks.
slot.act_handover_dockets.clean: U-Van der Merwe ukhiye ifayela e-safe. Ama-Hawks asevula idosi esemthethweni.
slot.act_handover_dockets.compromised: U-Van der Merwe ukuxwayisile ukuthi u-Mokoena unezinhloli ngaphakathi kwerekhodi lama-Hawks.
slot.act_handover_dockets.failure: U-Van der Merwe uphumele emsebenzini; ushiye imibhalo nesikhulu sasehhovisi esethukile.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.de: Vala iminyango yezindawo zokugcina imibhalo bese uthumela ubufakazi base-Berth 14 ku-The Daily Veld ukuze uqalise isiphetho se-Act 1.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.cl: I-uplink ka-Van der Merwe ixhumeke egumbini lezindaba le-The Daily Veld njengoba isikhathi sishaya phakathi kwamabili e-Berth 14.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.co: I-uplink isasebenza naphezu kwama-jammer esignali e-TRT ngaphandle kwenkantolo kamantshi.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.fa: Umsindo uphazamise ukusakazwa—umkhawulo wesikhathi waphakathi kwamabili e-Berth 14 ususondele.
clock.mokoena_sweep.desc: Amaphoyisa e-TRT ahlola i-CBD efuna u-Constable Nandi.
clock.nandi_condition.desc: Udinga ukuhlinzwa okuphuthumayo ngasese ngaphambi kokuba isilonda sithathe umhlaba.
clock.precinct_heat.desc: Izinhloli ze-SAPS nama-CCTV alandela ukunyakaza kwakho.
clock.audit_docket_409.desc: Landelela ama-invoice wamaloli amanzi ka-R400m uze ufike enkampanini yabo yomgunyathi.
clock.crack_auditor_phone.desc: Yeqa ukubhalwa kwemininingwane yezinto eziphilayo (biometrics) e-Golden Dragon Cyber-Pawn.
clock.berth_14_countdown.desc: Izinsuku ezisele ngaphambi kokuba impahla ka-Zuko iphume e-Pier 2 (Isiphetho se-Act 1).
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.title: Izibani eziluhlaza emgwaqeni omncane
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.speaker: Sergeant Dlamini
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.role: Ithimba le-SAPS Tactical Response Team (Mokoena Unit)
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Izicathulo zempi ziduma ezitebhisini zikakhonkolo e-Mercury Arcade. Ngemuva kwama-blinds, ama-Volkswagen Golf GTI amathathu angenazo izinombolo kanye ne-Nyala evikelwe ngezikhali kuvimbe zombili iziphetho zomgwaqo.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Isibhamu sishaya isango lakho lensimbi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Vula isango noma sizodubula izinkonjane! U-Brigadier Mokoena ufuna idocket yakhe!"
choice.choice_roof_escape.label: Nyonyoba phezu kophahla lwe-Arcade
choice.choice_roof_escape.desc: Thatha u-Nandi nedocket, khwela ngewindi lophahla, wehlele emgwaqeni wamatekisi.
choice.choice_roof_escape.log: Ubalekela phezu kwensimbi egqwalile phansi kwemvula. I-TRT ihlasela ifulethi elingenamuntu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.label: Nikeza u-Dlamini umvilophu onemali (R1,200)
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.desc: U-Sergeant Dlamini unezikweletu zokugembula e-Greyville. Mkhokhele ukuze abike ukuthi ifulethi belingenamuntu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.log: U-Dlamini ulinganisa imali, umemeza emsakazweni wakhe ukuthi ithiphu ibingamanga, bese ehoxisa ithimba lakhe.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.label: Nikeza amaphepha mbumbulu bese uvuma ukushaywa
choice.choice_burn_decoy.desc: Fihla amaphepha angempela ngaphansi kwaphansi bese uvumela i-TRT ikushaye.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.log: U-Dlamini ukushiya ulimele phansi, ethatha amaphepha mbumbulu ebuyela nawo e-Central Precinct.
event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Ukutheleleka okubi (Septic Shock)
event.evt_nandi_critical.speaker: Constable Nandi
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: UNandi uyazamazama kakhulu ngaphansi kwengubo emanzi te. Inxeba lenhlamvu eceleni kwembambo zakhe seliphenduke umbala onsomi, futhi uyaphaphama bese ehluleka ukuzibamba.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Uma umyisa esibhedlela sase-Addington noma e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli, irejista yezibhamu izokwazisa uBrigadier Mokoena kungakapheli imizuzu engamashumi amabili.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.label: Khokhela uDkt. Maharaj ukuhlinza okuphuthumayo (R1,500)
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.desc: Shayela udokotela osebenza ngasese onethuluzi lokushisa amanxeba nemithi elwa namagciwane.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.log: UDkt. Maharaj ukhipha izicucu zenhlamvu futhi uzinzisa uNandi ngaphambi kokusa.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.label: Shayela uColonel van der Merwe ukuze uthole odokotela base-Safe-House
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.desc: Kudinga ukwethenjwa ngama-Hawks. Nikela uNandi ethimbeni le-Old Archive ukuze athole ukwelashwa okuyimfihlo.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.log: UVan der Merwe ushushumbisa uNandi ngeloli lezingubo eliya emtholampilo osendaweni ekude.
choice.choice_public_hospital.label: Mlahle esibhedlela sikahulumeni bese ubaleka
choice.choice_public_hospital.desc: Umsindisa mahhala, kodwa uMokoena uzoqala ukukulandela ngokushesha.
choice.choice_public_hospital.log: Odokotela bayamzinzisa uNandi, kodwa amaphoyisa e-TRT azungeza isibhedlela kungakapheli ihora.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: Operation Shanela Lockdown
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.speaker: Metro Police Dispatch
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Imisindo yezinhlabo iyazwakala phakathi kwezakhiwo ezinde. Izibani ezinkulu nezimpawu eziwolintshi zivala izimpambano zomgwaqo e-CBD njengoba amaphoyisa e-SAPS ne-Metro emisa abantu ukuze babaseshe.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Yonke imikhumbi, amabhayisikili okuletha izimpahla, nabahamba ngezinyawo baseshwa ngezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni namadokodo antshontshiwe.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.label: Gibela kwi-VIP Kombi Convoy kaBra Bheki
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.desc: Sebenzisa igunya lakho kwi-Street Syndicate ukuze udlule kule ndawo ngemoto yenhlangano engathintwa muntu.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.log: Amaphoyisa e-Metro avumela i-Quantum kaBra Bheki ukuba idlule ngaphandle kokuhlola omazisi.
choice.choice_spot_fine.label: Khokha imali ye-"Cold Drink" endaweni (R600)
choice.choice_spot_fine.desc: Faka amaphepha amathathu ka-R200 ngaphakathi kwelayisensi yakho yokushayela bese uzithoba.
choice.choice_spot_fine.log: Iphoyisa lifaka imali ephaketheni, lishaye uphahla lwemoto yakho, bese likuvumela ukuba udlule.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.label: Linda kuze kudlule isikhathi emapayipini amanzi
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.desc: Chitha amahora uhamba emanzini angaphansi kwe-N2 kuze kube yilapho amaphoyisa esehamba.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.log: Uphuma emanzi te futhi ukhathele ekuseni, kodwa umkhondo wakho usuphelile.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: The Water-Tanker Pipeline
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: Ubeka amaphepha anegazi e-Docket #409 phezu kwetafula lakho ngaphansi kwesibani. Izinombolo ekugcineni ziyazwakala.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" ikhokhise i-City Hall u-R400 million ukuletha amanzi ezindaweni ezisenyakatho. Kodwa ama-GPS akhombisa ukuthi lawo maloli awazange aye ezindaweni ezidinga amanzi—ashayela eqonde e-Pier 2 Cold Storage eya ezindaweni zezimboni ngaphandle kwedolobha, ephelezelwa amaveni e-TRT kaBrigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: IKhansela uMa-Sibi akantshontshi nje imali yamanzi. Amaloli akhe athutha amakhemikhali okwenza izidakamizwa zikaZuko Ndlovu.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.label: Maka i-City Hall ne-Pier 2 kumephu
choice.choice_unlock_leads.desc: Ivula i-City Hall Annex (N4) ne-Pier 2 Cold Storage (N6) ukuze uphenye noma uqale ukwesabisa.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.log: Impumelelo: I-City Hall Annex ne-Pier 2 Cold Storage manje sezivuliwe kumephu yakho.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Voice Note from Berth 14
event.evt_phone_decrypted.speaker: Sparks
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: USparks ukhipha intuthu ye-vape njengoba ifoni yomcwaningi oshonile ivuleka. Ngaphakathi kukhona irekhodi eliyimfihlo nohlu lwezimpahla zanamuhla.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Kuleli rekhodi, izwi likaBrigadier Mokoena lizwakala kahle: "Susa izithiyo e-N2 phakathi kwamabili. I-container kaZuko izofika e-Berth 14, futhi noma ubani ovela kuma-Hawks ozama ukungena uzongcwatshwa emayini."
choice.choice_take_manifest.label: Landa uhlu lwe-Berth 14 noxhumana naye kuma-Hawks
choice.choice_take_manifest.desc: Ivula i-Old Archive Basement (N7) futhi ikunikeza amandla phezu kukaMokoena noZuko.
choice.choice_take_manifest.log: Uthatha i-drive. I-archive kaColonel van der Merwe manje isivulekile.
event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Midnight at Berth 14: The Final Play
event.evt_climax_berth14.speaker: Port Control & Tactical Dispatch
event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Imvula iyana e-Natal Port Channel njengoba o-crane abakhulu base-Pier 2 bebonakala enkungwini. Ngaphansi kwe-Berth 14, amaloli amathathu amanzi alindile eduze kwama-container kaZuko Ndlovu, ephelezelwa ama-Nyalas e-TRT kaBrigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Isikhathi sakho sesiphelile. Noma ngabe ufike lapha namadokodo, ama-voice note, noma amandla, unethuba elilodwa lokudlala ikhadi lakho ngaphambi kokuba leli qembu lihambe liye emgwaqeni u-N2.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.label: [VIGILANTE PATH] Phawula ama-Izinkabi kaBra Bheki bese ushisa leli qembu
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.desc: Vusa impi enkulu yasechwebeni phakathi kwe-Queen Street Syndicate namaqembu e-TRT ka-Mokoena, shisa amathangi amakhemikhali, futhi uphange u-R450,000 wemali yomgunyathi we-cartel.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.log: Izinhlamvu zokulandela zishisa imigqomo yezinto zokwakha e-Pier 2 njengoba ugqekeza iloli yomyalo futhi unyamalala ebumnyameni nemali yomgunyathi ye-cartel.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.label: [INDLELA YOMMBULI-MFIHLO] Sakaza i-Dossier ku-The Daily Veld & Hawks
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.desc: Dlulisa irejista yethangi lamanzi ehloliwe nokuqoshwa komsindo ka-Mokoena ezweni lonke ngenkathi uColonel van der Merwe ekhipha uConstable Nandi emuva kokumvikela njengofakazi.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.log: Ngehora lesi-06:00 ekuseni, inothi lezwi likaBrigadier Mokoena liyadlalwa kuzo zonke iziteshi zomsakazo eNingizimu Afrika kanti uMnyango Wezezimali uvala ithenda ka-Ma-Sibi ka-R400m.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.label: [INDLELA YOMPHATHI OMKHULU] Khuphukela e-The Glass House & Funa u-20% we-Pipeline
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.desc: Hlangana no-Zuko Ndlovu, iNhloko yabasebenzi baka-Ma-Sibi, kanye noBrigadier Mokoena phezulu ezilobeni zokusanhlamvu. Shisa i-Docket #409 wena uqobo ukuze ubuyiselwe emsebenzini futhi ube nguzakwethu we-syndicate.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.log: Uphonsa i-Docket #409 emlilweni phezulu e-The Glass House. Ukumiswa kwakho kususwa, futhi imali yakho yokuqala engu-R80,000 yethangi ifika ngaphambi kokusa.
choice.climax_choice_captured.label: [AKUKHO OKUNGASIZA] Ubanjwe ku-Pier 2 Perimeter Dragnet
choice.climax_choice_captured.desc: Ngaphandle kwerejista ebethelwe noma imininingwane ye-Berth 14 ekhishiwe, ababheki be-TRT baka-Mokoena bakuvimbezela ngaphambi kokuba ufike echwebeni.
choice.climax_choice_captured.log: Izimoto ezine ze-TRT Golf GTI ezinganambithiswanga zivimba ukuphunyuka kwakho emvuleni. I-Docket #409 ithathwa ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: I-Blackout Paranoia: Ukuwa Kwezinzwa
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Ingxoxo Yangaphakathi
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Izandla zakho aziyeki ukuthuthumela. Phakathi kwentuthu ye-diesel, ukukhala kwama-siren e-Queen Street, nezinyanga eziyisithupha ubheka emuva kwakho, umbono wakho uba mnyama.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: Uwa uze uqine ezitebhisini ezimanzi ze-Mercury Arcade, uzama ukuthola umoya. Uma ungazitholi izinzwa zakho manje, uzokwenza iphutha elibulalayo.
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.label: Thola ama-Amphetamine emakethe emnyama e-Arcade Kiosk (R500)
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.desc: Kuphoqa ukugxila kwakho ukuthi kubuye ngokushesha (+45% Ukuzola), nakuba umdayisi ekhuluma (+1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.log: Amaphilisi amakhemikhali ababayo ashukumisa uhlelo lwakho lwezinzwa ukuthi lubuyele ekugxileni (+45% Ukuzola, +1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.labe: Shayela uDokotela Wenkambu kaColonel van der Merwe (Hawks Rep >= 1)
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.desc: Sebenzisa ukwethenjwa kwakho kuma-Hawks ukuze uthole umjovo we-adrenaline ohlanzekile nokubhekwa okuphikisayo (+50% Ukuzola).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.log: Udokotela wama-Hawks osethathe umhlalaphansi ukwelapha ngemuva kweloli elingafakiwe uphawu (+50% Ukuzola, -1 Sweep).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.label: Lala phansi esitezi sendlu ephephile kuze kume ukuthuthumela
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.desc: Kubuyisela +35% Ukuzola mahhala, kodwa ulahlekelwa amahora ayigugu ngenkathi inethi ka-Mokoena iqina (+1 Sweep, +1 Nandi’s Wound).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.log: Uvuka amahora kamuva phansi esitezi esibandayo (+35% Ukuzola, kodwa ama-Threat Clocks ayathuthuka).
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Ucingo Olubethelwe: Igatsha Lomnqumo Lesitezi sesi-4
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.speaker: INhloko yabasebenzi bakaCouncillor Ma-Sibi
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Njengoba amatekisi ekuseni eqala ukukhala e-Queen Street, ifoni yakho encane idlidliza ngomyalezo we-Signal ongafakwanga ovela esitezi sesi-4 se-City Hall.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Siyazi ukuthi uConstable Nandi ukulethele amaphepha kaMandla Sithole. Akekho e-City Hall ofuna omunye umngcwabo. Yehlisa ijubane lokuhlola kwakho namuhla, futhi u-R800 wemali yokubonisana kamasipala uzofakwa ebhokisini lakho leposi kungakapheli ihora."
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.lab: Yamukela u-R800 "Consulting Retainer" & Dlala kanye nabo
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.des: Faka u-R800 ephaketheni futhi uthole +1 City Hall Rep, kodwa kubiza -10% Ukuzola njengoba ubekezelela inkohlakalo.
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.log: Umthunywa ushiya imvilophu kamasipala ensundu eno-R800 okhishwe ebhokisini lakho leposi (+R800, +1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.label: Landelela emuva i-Header yomyalezo we-Burner (WIRE >= 1)
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.desc: Sebenzisa ikhono lakho lezimpawu ukukhipha imethadatha emyalezweni weNhloko yabasebenzi (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.log: Uthatha isitifiketi seseva kamasipala kusuka ku-header yomyalezo (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.label: Phula i-SIM ye-Burner phakathi & Qhubeka Nokumba
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.desc: Nqaba ukuthengwa (+10% Ukuzola, +1 Hawks Rep, -1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.log: Uphula ikhadi le-SIM phakathi bese ulijikijela emseleni wamanzi (+10% Ukuzola, +1 Hawks Rep).
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Dispatch Yasekuseni: Ikhebula lase-Umgeni Likhishiwe
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.location: West Street & Umgeni Corridor • Cycle 3 Dawn
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Intuthu emnyama egqamile ikhuphuka esiteshini sase-Umgeni ekuseni. I-syndicate yokweba ithusi ikhiphe izintambo ezintathu zikagesi ophezulu ebusuku, yenza izibani zomgwaqo ze-CBD zibe yisiphithiphithi.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Abaphathi bemizila bakaBra Bheki bathathe izimpambano zemigwaqo ngamakhwela nezinduku, kanti amaveni amaphoyisa e-SAPS abambeke ethrafikini emgwaqweni olandelayo.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.label: Siza abaphathi bakaBra Bheki ukuhlela kabusha umugqa wasekuseni
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.desc: Thola u-R500 kubaphathi bomugqa kanye +1 Street Syndicate standing.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.log: Ususa umzila wokulethwa kwempahla wama-Quantum kaBra Bheki futhi ufaka u-R500 ephaketheni (+R500, +1 Street Syndicate Rep).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.label: Sebenzisa ukushuba kukagesi ukusula amakhamera e-ANPR esiteshini samaphoyisa
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.desc: Sebenzisa ukwehla kukagesi esiteshini esincane ukusula amarekhodi amapuleti ezimoto (-2 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.log: Ukushuba kukagesi konakalisa amarekhodi amakhamera omgwaqo angamahora angu-24 edlule esiteshini sase-Central (-2 Precinct Heat).
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Ucingo oluphuthumayo: Umkhumbi i-MV Southern Cross uya e-Berth 14
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Uphondo lomkhumbi lukhala enkungwini yetheku njengoba umkhumbi i-MV Southern Cross udlula emkhunjini. Umsakazo wakho okhodiwe uqala ukukhalisa izwi lika-Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Lalela kahle. Imigqomo yamakhemikhali ka-Zuko Ndlovu ithululwa e-Berth 14 ebusuku, kanti amaveni e-TRT ka-Mokoena asevele alindile e-weighbridge. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola i-Decoded Tanker Ledger noma i-Berth 14 Manifest ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi sishaye phakathi kwamabili."
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.label: Hlola amafayela akho obufakazi bese uzilungiselela ubusuku
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.log: I-MV Southern Cross isethekwini. Ubusuku obubalulekile bokuqeda i-Berth 14 (+15% Composure).
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.title: Ukudubulana ku-M4 Flyover
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.speaker: Izinkabi eziqashwe ngaphandle kwesifundazwe
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p1: Amabakkie amabili amhlophe angenazo izinombolo akuvimbezela ngemoto yakho odongeni lwe-M4 coastal flyover. Ukukhanya kwezibhamu kukhanyisa imvula njengoba izinhlamvu zishaya iwindi lakho.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: UZuko no-Brigadier Mokoena basebenzise izinkabi zabo eziqashwe ngaphandle kwesifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awufiki enkantolo enkulu (High Court) ukuyofakaza.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.label: Shayisa ibakkie eliphambili bese ubuyisela umlilo (STREET >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.desc: Dabula ekuvimbezelweni ngokucophelela (-2 Hit Squad, -10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.log: Ushayisa ibakkie eliphambili uliwisele emaphethelweni omgwaqo bese unyamalala emigwaqweni yelokishi elisenyakatho (Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.label: Thumela u-R900 ngo-Bra Bheki’s Rank Marshals ukuze ukhanselise inkontileka
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.desc: Sebenzisa imigudu yezigebengu kanye no-R900 ukuthenga izinkabi.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.log: Ucingo olulodwa oluvela e-Queen Street lwenza izinkabi ziyeke ukukulandela (-R900, Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.label: Gxuma uphumele emseleni wamanzi
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.desc: Usinda ngokulimala kancane (-30% Composure, +1 Contempt Warrant), kodwa ubaleka endaweni yokubulawa.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.log: Imoto yakho igcwele izinhlamvu njengoba ugingqika emseleni ogcwele amanzi (-30% Composure, Hit Squad reset).
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.title: Incwadi Yokuboshwa Ngenxa Yokwedelela Umthetho
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.speaker: Advocate Vermeulen
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p1: Amaphoyisa ahlomile kanye nezinhloli zikahulumeni bakuzungezile ezitebhisini ze-High Court, bephethe incwadi yokuboshwa esayinwe ngaphansi komthetho we-Protection of State Information Act.
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "Uyalwa ukuba uboshwe ngenxa yokutholakala namarekhodi angavumelekile engqalasizinda kamasipala."
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.label: Sebenzisa u-Section 205 Whistleblower Immunity (DOCKETS >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.desc: Chitha incwadi yokuboshwa enkantolo (+1 Hawks Rep, resets Contempt Warrant).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.log: IJaji u-Khumalo lichitha incwadi yokuboshwa phambi kwamakhamera (Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.label: Khokha u-R800 we-Emergency Senior Counsel Bail
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.desc: Khokha u-R800 ukuze uhlale ngaphandle kweseli.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.log: Ummeli wakho uthola isinqumo sesikhashana esikugcina ungaboshiwe (-R800, Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.label: Baleka usebenzisa umhubhe ongaphansi komhlaba wama-Magistrates
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.desc: Gwema ukuboshwa kodwa ulahlekelwe ngu -25% Composure kanye +1 Hit Squad heat.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.log: Ubaleka emhubheni wamarekhodi ngaphambi kokuba bakubophe (-25% Composure, +1 Hit Squad).
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.title: Ukuvezwa kweqiniso: I-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.location: High Court Evidence Vault • Encrypted Uplink
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p1: Umshini wokuphrinta ehhovisi lika-Colonel van der Merwe uyaqala ukusebenza, ukhipha amarekhodi abanikazi be-Sovereign Pearl Holdings base-Dubai.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: Nanka amagama amnyama nokumhlophe: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), kanye no-Brigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—kanye nokuqashwa kwendiza i-Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) elindile e-King Shaka Hangar 7 kanye nezitifiketi zomhlaba e-Lot 44 e-Midlands.
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.labe: Qinisekisa i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed bese uvula imikhondo emisha
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.desc: Yengeza i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed ohlwini lwakho lwezinto futhi uvule i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.log: Uthole i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed! Uvule i-Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.title: Ukuqhekeza: I-Telemetry yase-Midlands Packhouse
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p1: I-GPS plot ka-Sparks ihambisana kahle nemephu yezolimo yesifundazwe. Wonke amaloli amanzi kamasipala abhalelwe amalayisense emijondolo esenyakatho empeleni ayedluliselwa emgwaqeni u-N3 eya e-Lot 44: i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Okungcono kakhulu, ama-cargo manifest akhombisa amathani angu-1.8 omkhiqizo oqediwe we-crystal efakwe emaphalethini ewolintshi athunyelwa e-Hangar 7 e-King Shaka International Airport ngobusuku banamuhla.
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.label: Bhalisa i-Midlands Batch Telemetry futhi uvule izindawo ezikude
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.desc: Yengeza i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry ohlwini lwakho futhi uvule i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.log: Uthole i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry! Uvule i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.p: Amaphephandaba ase-KwaZulu-Natal aphethe izihloko ezinkulu ezivela kwi-Commission of Inquiry. E-Umhlanga Ridge, imishini yokuchitha amaphepha isebenza ngokweqile njengoba abaqondisi bezinkampani zama-shell bephuthuma ukubhukha izindiza e-King Shaka.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.la: Nikeza imininingwane kwi-Court Press Gallery (+1 Trace Trust, +1 Contempt)
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.de: Gcina amehlo omphakathi egxile ku-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.lo: Iphakethe lakho lezindaba elingaziwa liphoqa abaqondisi bebhange ukuba bazivikele (+1 Trace Trust).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.label: Shintsha izimoto zokuphepha futhi ugcine u-Nandi efihliwe
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.desc: Dukisa ababheki baka-Zuko (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.log: Ushintsha amapuleti egalaji elingaphansi, ushiya iqembu elizokubulala lizulazula ehhotela elingenamuntu (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: Ukundiza e-Hangar 7: Isiphetho Sokugcina
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.speaker: Zuko Ndlovu, Cllr. Ma-Sibi & Brig. Mokoena
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Imvula efudumele yasogwini ishaya ukhonkolo okhanyiswe ngamalambu e-Hangar 7. Ama-turbine amabili e-Rolls-Royce e-Gulfstream ZS-900 akhala kakhulu njengoba abasebenzi belayisha amaphalethi okugcina ama-bearer bonds nezikhwama zediplomacy.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Phansi kwezitebhisi zendiza kumi abakhi abathathu bokubanjwa kwe-eThekwini-Gold: u-Zuko Ndlovu egqoke ijazi lakhe elihlanzekile, u-Councillor Ma-Sibi ephethe ipasipoti yakhe yediplomacy, kanye no-Brigadier Mokoena ephethe isibhamu sakhe esikhombe kuthala emanzi.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokundiza, Warrant Officer," kusho u-Zuko ngaphezu komsindo wendiza. "Nquma ukuthi hlobo luni lwezwe ozovuka kulo kusasa."
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.labe: [UKUHLULELWA KOMTHETHO-SISEKELO] Khipha izincwadi zokuboshwa ze-High Court futhi umise i-ZS-900
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.desc: Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Hola iyunithi yama-Hawks ka-Col. van der Merwe kuthala ubabophe bobathathu phambi kwezwe lonke.
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.log: Izimoto ezihlomile zama-Hawks zivala umzila njengoba wethula icala le-High Court ngesibhamu.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.lab: [UKUVUKELA KWABANTU] Thatha amaloli amanzi futhi unikeze izigidi zase-Midlands imijondolo
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.des: Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Vumela amaphoyisa esiteleka ka-Bra Bheki ahlasele i-Hangar 7, athathe imali ye-syndicate engu-R400m, futhi avule amanzi.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.log: Amakhulu amatekisi namaloli kamasipala aphula uthango, ethatha ingcebo ye-cartel eyimijondolo.
choice.choice_act2_ending_syndicate_stat: [I-GHOST SOVEREIGN] Vumela i-ZS-900 ihambe ngokushintshana nezihluthulelo ze-Master Trust
Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Vumela osopolitiki babalekele e-Dubai ngenkathi uthatha umyalo ophelele wemboni yezokuthutha yesithunzi yesifundazwe.
U-Zuko ukuphonsela ukhiye we-cryptographic kusuka ezitebhisini njengoba i-ZS-900 igijima emzileni iqonde esivunguvungwini.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.label: [UNGENAZIKHALI KUTHALA] Bhekana ne-Triumvirate ngaphandle kobufakazi obuqinisekisiwe
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.desc: Uma ufike e-Hangar 7 ngaphandle kwe-Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry, abaqaphi baka-Mokoena bavalela iminyango ye-hangar ngemuva kwakho.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.log: Ngaphandle kobufakazi be-High Court, amalambu e-hangar ayacima kanti umsindo wendiza umisa ukudubula kwakho kokugcina.
ending.ending_vigilante.title: Umlilo Wasechwebeni
ending.ending_vigilante.subtitle: Pier 2 Container Terminal • 01:40 AM (Stage 6 Blackout)
ending.ending_vigilante.quote: "Uma umthetho uthengiwe futhi umbuso uthunjiwe, ubulungiswa obusele kuphela umdlalo owushisayo ebumnyameni."
ending.ending_vigilante.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Njengoba impi yezindawo isabalala emijondolo esenyakatho, ikhomishini kazwelonke yophenyo ifika ivela e-Pretoria—futhi bobabili u-Zuko no-Mokoena bafuna uthule ngaphambi kokuba ufakaze.

ending.ending_whistleblower.subtitle: Old Archive Sub-Basement & National Broadcast • 06:00 AM
ending.ending_whistleblower.quote: "Bangashisa idokodo lephepha bathenge nomantshi, kodwa abakwazi ukubuyisela amakhulu amane ezigidi zama-Rand ebumnyameni uma izwe lonke selizwile irekhodi."
ending.ending_whistleblower.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Njengoba u-Mokoena ebalekile njengempi yempi kanti u-Nandi elungiselela ukufakaza e-High Court, kufanele ugcine ufakazi wakho obalulekile ephila amahora angu-72.

ending.ending_kingpin.subtitle: Penthouse Atop the Harbour Grain Silos • Midnight
ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "E-eThekwini-Gold, akekho onqoba umshini. Noma ucindezelwa ngaphansi kwamathenka, noma uthenga isihlalo kuleli valvu."
ending.ending_kingpin.hook: ISIGABA 2: UConstable Nandi uyala ukuthatha imali yakho yegazi bese enyamalala emalokishini ephethe ikhophi yedokodo—lokhu kukuphoqa ukuba uzingele owayengumlingani wakho.

ending.ending_captured.subtitle: Izimayini Zegolide Nezamalahle Ezilahliwe Ngaphandle Kwedolobha • Ngaphambi Kokusa
ending.ending_captured.quote: "Idolobha aliyidingi inkantolo uma ukucishwa kukagesi kwe-Stage 6 nebakkie engabhalisiwe kwenza umsebenzi ngaphambi kokusa."
ending.ending_captured.hook: ZAMA OKUNYE: Lawula ukuzola kwakho, sebenzisa inethiwekhi yamatekisi yase-Queen Street ukuze wehlise ijubane le-Sweep ka-Mokoena, uvule i-Pier 2 ngaphambi kokuba isicupho sivaleke.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.title: Kubukhoma Kuthelevishini Kazwelonke
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.subtitle: King Shaka Hangar 7 & Izitebhisi ZeNkantolo Ephakeme • Ukusa
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Okokuqala eminyakeni engamashumi amabili, ama-siren aluhlaza ayengasusi ithrafikhi ngenxa yezikhulu—ayezithatha ngezibopho zezandla."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: UMKHANKASO UQEDIWE (ISIGABA 1 + 2): Usindile ekucishweni kukagesi, wadalula uzungu lwe-Sovereign Pearl, futhi waletha ubulungiswa kwabangathintwa base-eThekwini-Gold.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.title: Ikhonvoy Yabantu
ending.ending_act2_revolution.subtitle: Idamu LaseNyakatho Nelokishi & Hangar 7 • Ukusa
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Bantshontshe amanzi basidayisela isomiso. Namuhla ebusuku sithathe amaloli, ompompi, ne-akhawunti yasebhange."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: UMKHANKASO UQEDIWE (ISIGABA 1 + 2): Uphule inhlangano yezigebengu zombuso kusukela phansi waphindisela amanzi ase-eThekwini-Gold kubantu bawo.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.title: Usihlalo Webhodi
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Imibuso ayiwi uma inkosi igibela indiza. Ishintsha nje amasiginesha kudeedi lokuthembela."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: UMKHANKASO UQEDIWE (ISIGABA 1 + 2): Udlule wonke amaqembu e-eThekwini-Gold futhi wathatha isihlalo sombuso wethunzi.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.title: Kuvalwe Iminyaka Engamashumi Ahlahlanisithupha
ending.ending_act2_vanished.subtitle: King Shaka Cargo Apron • 01:15 AM
ending.ending_act2_vanished.quote: "Ngomyalo kaSihlalo, i-Exhibit 409-B ihlukaniswa ngaphansi kwemithetho ye-National Key Points."
ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: ZAMA ISIGABA 2 FUTHI: Qedela iwashi elithi "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" (e-Ridge noma eNkantolo Ephakeme) noma iwashi elithi "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" (e-Northern Township Depot) ngaphambi kokunqanda i-Flight ZS-900!
bg.forensic_hawk.title: Umcwaningi Wamacala Emali
bg.forensic_hawk.tagline: Ulandela amaRandi ezinkampanini ezingamambuka nakumathenda kamasipala.
bg.forensic_hawk.desc: UBhBrigadiye Mokoena wakubeka icala ngamanga ngesikhathi ukuhlolwa kwakho kwamathangi amanzi kamasipala kusondela kakhulu eHholo Ledolobha. Awukwazi ukulwa nethimba lababulali ubuso nobuso, kodwa uma unikezwe ibhuku lezimali nomabhalane wenkantolo, ungabhidliza umbuso wonke.
bg.trt_breacher.title: Umphoqeleli Oshile
bg.trt_breacher.tagline: Uyazi ukuthi amabutho kaMokoena asebenza kanjani ngoba wawuhola elilodwa lawo.
bg.trt_breacher.desc: Wadilizela iminyango kusukela KwaMashu kuya ePoint waze wenqaba umyalo wokuhlela ukudubulana ePier 2. Bonke abaphathi bamatekisi nabaphathi beziteshi bayabazi ubuso bakho—futhi bahlonipha ukukhalipha kwesibhamu sakho.
bg.crime_intel.title: Umhloli Wezingcingo Zomshoshaphansi
bg.crime_intel.tagline: Ukwelashwa kwemibhoshongo yamaselula, ama-transponder mbumbulu, nokusabisa okungekho emthethweni.
bg.crime_intel.desc: Wawuhlala ngemuva kweveni elingenamphawulo ulalele abaphathi bezigelekeqe behlebezela amakhansela edolobha. Ngesikhathi othile ecisha iseva enkulu wasolwa wena ngalokho, wagcina amadrayivu ayisipele efihliwe kuyo yonke i-CBD.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Ngehora lesibili ekuseni, ugesi kamasipala uyafa ngokuduma okukhulu okuvela esiteshini esise-Queen Street. Ifeni yophahla iyama. Ngaphandle kwamafasitela akho, imvula yasogwini ishaya ophahleni lwensimbi lwe-Mercury Arcade, ikhanyiswe kuphela ukukhanya okuphuzi kwejeneretha kadizili yesitolo esiseduze.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Etafuleni lakho kukhona ibhodlela lotshwala bomoba elingaphelele nencwadi yokumiswa umsebenzi esayinwe nguBrigadier Titus Mokoena ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Bese kuzwakala umsindo—hhayi insimbi yaphansi, kodwa ukushaywa okuthathu okusheshayo nokumanzi esangweni lakho lensimbi i-Trellidor phezulu ezitebhisini zokubaleka. Ngaphambi kokuba ufinyelele ku-9mm Parabellum ngaphansi kukamatilasi wakho, khumbula ukuthi wawungubani ngaphambi kokuba uMokoena angcwabe umsebenzi wakho:
popt.pick_forensic.label: Khetha Isizinda: Umhloli Wephepha (+2 Dockets, +1 Influence)
popt.pick_breacher.label: Khetha Isizinda: Isiphathi Esishile (+2 Street, +1 Dockets)
popt.pick_intel.label: Khetha Isizinda: Uhloli Wocingo (+2 Wire, +1 Influence)
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: Ulayisha i-Z88 yakho bese usuka eceleni kohlaka lomnyango. Ngembobo yokubuka, isibani esiphuthumayo esishajekayo siyacwayiza phezu kwebhantshi le-SAPS elimanzi.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: NguConstable Nandi—okuyiyena kuphela oqalayo esiteshini owenqaba ukusayina i-affidavit yamanga ka-Mokoena ngawe. Ubambe izimbambo zakhe ezingakwesobunxele, igazi elimnyama liphuma phakathi kweminwe yakhe, ephethe idokodo elinzima elinsundu nefoni eqhekekile ngaphansi kwengalo yakhe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." uyaphefumula, amehlo ebheke emthunzini wezitebhisi. "Vula isango. Ngicela. Amaveni e-TRT ka-Mokoena asanda kudlula endaweni yamatekisi. Uma i-transponder yomsakazo wami isasebenza, basemabhuloki amabili ngemuva kwami."
popt.opt_wire_kill_radio.label: [WIRE] Khipha ibhethri ne-GPS module ocingweni lwakhe lwe-SAPS kuqala
popt.opt_street_clear_alley.label: [STREET] Hlola indlela, umfake ngaphakathi, bese ukhiye isango
popt.opt_standard_pull_in.label: Vula i-Trellidor umfake phansi ekhishini
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: Ucindezela ithawula elihlanzekile ohlangothini lwakhe. Isibhamu esingu-9mm simlimaze kancane ezimbambeni—sijule ngokwanele ukuba siphume igazi njalo, kodwa siyingozi kakhulu ukuthungwa esibhedlela sikahulumeni lapho ababhalisi bamaphoyisa bebhala khona wonke umuntu odutshuliwe.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: UNandi ufaka i-Docket #409 nefoni enegazi ezandleni zakho. "Siphendule ekugetshengeni kwemali e-N2 south ramp phakathi kwamabili. Iveni ye-G4S iqhushunyezwe nge-C4, Warrant. Kodwa bekungekho mali ngaphakathi."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: Uginqa amathe, ethuthumela. "Bekukhona umhloli kamasipala ofile eboshwe ngezandla phansi, nale rejista. Amakhulu amane ezigidi zamaRandi emathendeni aphuthumayo wamaloli amanzi adluliswe ehhovisi likaKhansela Ma-Sibi ngqo ezinqolobaneni zechweba zikaZuko Ndlovu. Lapho umlingani wami ezama ukukubika, uBrigadier Mokoena wafika ngebakkie ye-TRT engabhalisiwe... wamdubula esifubeni."
popt.opt_dockets_inspect.label: [DOCKETS] Vula i-Docket #409 ubheke izitembu zokugunyazwa kwesikhwama
popt.opt_influence_calm_nandi.label: [INFLUENCE] "Phefumula, Nandi. U-Mokoena akazi ukuthi le flat ikhona. Usaphila."
popt.opt_ask_phone.label: "Ekamubani le foni? Futhi ubani omunye okubonile ubaleka ku-N2?"
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: U-Nandi uquleka kusofa wakho njengoba ukusa okumpunga kwase-coast kukhanya ngama-blinds. Ngaphandle, amatekisi okuqala aqala ukushaya amakilaksoni e-Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: Unezinkinga ezimbili ezikukhathazayo: Isilonda sika-Nandi sokudutshulwa sizobola zingakapheli izinsuku ezine ngaphandle kokuthi ukhokhele udokotela ongabhalisiwe (R1,500), kanti ama-TRT squads ka-Brigadier Mokoena ahlola isifunda indlu ngendlu.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Ezandleni zakho kukhona ubufakazi obuxhumanisa i-City Hall, i-SAPS Organized Crime, kanye ne-Abasanta Cartel. Amadayisi akho ansuku zonke alungile etafuleni.
popt.opt_start_game.label: Yiya kumephu yesifunda (Qala u-Cycle 1)
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.title: Ngena kwi-Fiduciary Escrow Server
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.desc: Ngena kwi-server yokuphatha ingcebo esitezi sama-28 ukuze uthole i-Sovereign Pearl offshore shell trust.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.clean: Ukungena okuhlanzekile. Ukhopha ama-bearer-share certificates e-DIFC Dubai ngaphambi kokuthi i-firewall yezokuphepha isabele.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.compromise: Uthola uhhafu wama-registry, kodwa i-alarm ethule ikhomba i-MAC address yakho kuthimba lezomthetho (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.failure: Ama-biometric shutters ayavaleka. Ubaleka ngesikhathi ngezitebhisi zabasebenzi njengoba onogada abahlomile behlola i-lobby.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.title: Cindezela u-Tender Consultant e-Sky-Bar
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.desc: Valela ummeli wentela ka-Councillor Ma-Sibi phezu kwe-scotch bese ufuna imali yokuthula.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.clean: Ufaka i-platinum casino chip kanye no-R1,100 wemali etafileni, ethembisa ukubambezela i-contempt warrant.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.compromis: Ukhokha u-R650 ephaketheni ukuze igama lakhe lingaveli, kodwa onogada bakhe bathatha izithombe zamapuleti emoto yakho.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.failure: Uyakuhleka ebusweni bese eshayela iklerki lezokuphepha le-Commission ukubika ukwesatshiswa kofakazi.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.title: Khipha i-Black-Box GPS kwi-Tanker #114
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.desc: Vula i-dashboard telemetry unit yetankeri likamasipala ukuze ulandelele ukuma kwalo ebusuku e-Midlands.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.clean: Njengoba amaphoyisa ka-Bra Bheki elindile, ukhipha ama-coordinates ase-Howick highway (+2 Lab Telemetry).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.compromised: Uyakhipha i-GPS module, kodwa umuntu we-cartel oqaphelayo uyakubona (+1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.failure: Izintambo zokubasa zikhipha amalangabi ezandleni zakho, okudonsela onogada bendawo.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.title: Hlela ne-Strike Committee (R400)
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.desc: Khokhela amaphoyisa omphakathi wamanzi ukuthi abeke imigoqo ezokwehlisa ijubane lama-hit squads e-cartel.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.clean: Amathayi avuthayo nemigoqo yamatekisi ivala imigwaqo esenyakatho—izibhamu zika-Zuko ziphoqeleka ukuhlehla (-2 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.compromis: Amaphoyisa esiteleka ashintsha umzila wethrafikhi ukuze angadluli endaweni yakho (-1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.failure: Ama-Nyalas e-SAPS ahlakaza umugqa wokuvikela ngama-stun grenades ngaphambi kokuthi imigoqo ibambe.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.title: Faka i-Section 205 Offshore Subpoena
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.desc: Sebenzisana nabaholi bobufakazi baka-Colonel van der Merwe ukuphoqa amabhange ukuthi adandalise i-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.clean: Ujaji Khumalo usayina i-oda. Isikhulu sebhange silayisha ama-wire transfers kungakapheli ihora (+2 Trust, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.compromi: Ummeli wezomthetho ufaka izicelo eziphuthumayo, kodwa uthola ikhasi elibalulekile (+1 Trust).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.failure: Ummeli ka-Mokoena ukusola ngokwakha ubufakazi enkantolo (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.title: Debrief e-Witness Protection Safe-Room (R300)
slot.slot_recess_debrief.desc: Phuza ikhofi futhi uhlanze amanxeba emakamelweni aqinile e-Hawks ngaphansi kwe-Courtroom A ukuze uzole.
slot.slot_recess_debrief.clean: Constable Nandi—osehamba ngezinduku—ubuyekeza isikhathi sakho phezu kwetiye le-rooibos (+25% Composure, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.compromised: Amahora amabili okulela ngemuva kwengilazi engangeni zinhlamvu kubuyisa ukugxila kwakho (+15% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.failure: Izintatheli zishaya iminyango yegumbi usuku lonke, okukushiya ukhathele (+5% Composure).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.title: Ngena kwi-Packhouse B Synthesis Vats
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.desc: Dlula ezinjeni ukuze uthathe izithombe zamathankeri amanzi kamasipala efaka izinto kwi-packhouse. Isigaba 6 sicisha ugesi ocingweni (+2).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.clean: Ebumnyameni uthatha izithombe zomugqa wokukhiqiza futhi uthatha u-R900 wemali e-safe yomphathi.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.compromis: Uthola ama-serial numbers, kodwa izibani ziyavuleka njengoba izinja zishaya ucingo.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.failure: Amasosha aqashwayo adubula ngezibhamu ze-R5 esuka embhoshongweni. Ubaleka ngomsele wamanzi uze umanzi te.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.title: [FINALE] Hlasela i-Midlands Super-Lab
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.desc: Hola amaphoyisa esiteleka noma i-Hawks tactical team ngqo kwi-Packhouse B ngaphambi kokuthi ubufakazi bushise.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.clean: Uphula amasango e-packhouse futhi uthatha i-ledger—uphoqa u-Zuko no-Mokoena ukuthi babaleke beya e-Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.compromised: Phakathi kokudubulana okukhulu uthola ama-synthesis vats njengoba i-convoy yama-syndicate igijima iya e-King Shaka Airport!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.failure: I-packhouse iyasha, okubangela ukubhekana kokugcina e-King Shaka Hangar 7!
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.title: Khiya i-Gulfstream ZS-900 Avionics
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.desc: Shintsha i-radar transponder ukuze umise indiza ka-Zuko eya e-Dubai. Isigaba 6 sicisha i-radar yasetarmac (+2).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.clean: Ufaka iphutha lokusha kwenjini kwi-computer yendiza i-ZS-900, ubambezela ukusuka (-1 Flight Countdown, -1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.compromis: I-Air Traffic Control ibambe indiza yokuqasha emngceleni wendlela yezindiza (-1 Ukubalwa kwezikhathi zendiza).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.failure: Abadubuli be-SAPS TRT abaphezu kophahla lwe-hangar babone ukuxhumana kwakho kwe-laser ngaphesheya kwetiyela elimanzi.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.title: [ISIPHETHO] Thiya indiza i-ZS-900 e-Hangar 7
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.desc: Shayela ungene endaweni egcwele imvula njengoba u-Zuko Ndlovu, uMkhandlu u-Ma-Sibi, kanye noBrigadier Mokoena begibela i-Gulfstream.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.clean: Izibani zemoto yakho zikhanyise isondo elingaphambili le-Gulfstream—uvala indlela yezindiza ukuze kube nokubalwa kwezimali kokugcina!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.compromised: Uphahlaze umngcele we-Hangar 7 ngesikhathi izinjini zendiza ziqala ukujikeleza!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.failure: Uthola izinhlamvu ezivela kubantu abaphelezela u-Mokoena, ushelele ungena endaweni yezindiza njengoba izitebhisi zokugibela ziqala ukubuyela emuva!
clock.cartel_hit_squad.desc: U-Zuko noBrigadier Mokoena baqashe izigebengu ezingaphandle kwesifundazwe ukuze bakuthulise ngaphambi kokuba iKhomishini iphethe.
clock.commission_subpoena.title: Ukudelela & Iwaranti Yezokuphepha
clock.commission_subpoena.desc: Abashushisi abakhohlakele ngaphakathi koPhenyo bakha iwaranti yokukubopha ngaphansi kwemithetho Yezokuphepha Zikahulumeni.
clock.trace_offshore_trust.title: Landela i-Sovereign Pearl Trust
clock.trace_offshore_trust.desc: Hlanganisa amarejista ezinkampani zase-Umhlanga Ridge kanye nezincwadi zenkantolo ephakeme ukuze uveze abanikazi bama-Dubai.
clock.compile_ballistics_file.title: Hlanganisa i-Telemetry ye-Super-Lab
clock.compile_ballistics_file.desc: Khipha izingodo zomzila we-GPS emalolini amanzi ase-Northern Township aboshiwe ukuze uthole indawo yokwenziwa kwamakhemikhali.
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.title: Ukuhamba kwendiza yokuqasha i-ZS-900
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.desc: Ukubalwa kwezikhathi kuze kube u-Zuko Ndlovu, u-Ma-Sibi, no-Mokoena bagibela i-Gulfstream eya e-Dubai e-King Shaka Hangar 7.
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Ungavuli amakhethini, Sbu. Ama-Golf GTI ka-Mokoena angaphekiwe azungeza umgwaqo u-Anton Lembede njalo ngemizuzu engamashumi amabili. Ababulalanga nje u-Auditor Sithole e-Umgeni weighbridge—babemlindile ngenkathi ama-transponder ethekwini esesuliwe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Konke u-Sithole afela khona kuse-Docket #409 naleyo foni ephukile. Ngitshele ukuthi ngeke sife kuleli fulethi ngobusuku banamuhla."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Ngichazele futhi ngokuhlaselwa kwe-N2 weighbridge. Ubani odonse isibhamu?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Bheka lezi zikhathi ze-weighbridge nami. Yimaphi amapuleti amaloli abeyizipoki?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Khombisa Ubufakazi: I-Ledger yeloli lamanzi ebetshiwe] "Ngilandele inkampani yeqola. U-Ma-Sibi no-Zuko bangabanikazi bamaloli."
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Phumula, Nandi. Gcina umnyango uvaliwe ngenkathi ngisebenza emgwaqweni."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Izimoto ezimbili ezinezibani eziluhlaza zisivalela ngemva nje kwe-off-ramp yase-Umgeni. UBrigadier Mokoena akazange agqoke ngisho ne-balaclava. Uphume egqoke izingubo zakhe ze-TRT, wabheka isikhwama sika-Sithole, watshela i-corporal yakhe ukuthi ishise imoto."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ngingqongqoze ngaya emseleni wamanzi nephepha lokuqala ngaphansi kwesikibha sami. Uma u-Sparks e-Golden Dragon ekwazi ukuqhekeza ifoni ka-Sithole, izwi lika-Mokoena likuleyo nothi yezwi."
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "Masibuyele ezinkethweni zethu."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi leyo nothi yezwi iyaphuma."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Nanka—amapuleti ND-449-102 kuya ku-118. Bakhokhise i-City Hall izigidi ezingamashumi amane nambili zamaRandi ukuze balethe amanzi okuphuza e-KwaMashu ngesikhathi sombalane, kodwa bheka ama-toll tags kadizili. Abazange baphendukele enyakatho."
"Lonke iloli lashayela laqonda e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ngo-01:30 ekuseni. Bathwele izinto zamakhemikhali zika-Zuko Ndlovu ngaphansi kwegama lamanzi kamasipala."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Lokho kungisindisa amahora okuhlola ama-ledger. Bamba kancane."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... amaphesenti angamashumi ayisithupha e-Abasanta Maritime, amaphesenti angamashumi amane e-trust yomndeni ka-Ma-Sibi. Ukufezile ngempela, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Yisa lokhu ku-Colonel van der Merwe e-Old Archive Basement—noma ushise i-Berth 14 wena ngokwakho. Noma yikuphi, ngeke baphume bengajezisiwe."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Ungazikhandli. Singena esigabeni sokugcina."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Umphathi wamatekisi e-Queen Street • Umxazululi wezinkinga
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, owayeyiphoyisa le-Hawk uhamba e-Queen Street ngenkathi abafana baka-Mokoena be-TRT bephenya wonke amatekisi e-Warwick Junction. Unesibindi, Sbu, ngiyakuvuma lokho."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Akukho okuhambayo e-CBD ngaphandle kokuba abashayeli bami bakubone kuqala—hhayi ama-Nyalas e-SAPS, futhi nakanjani hhayi lawo maloli amanzi kamasipala asindayo ngo-02:00 ekuseni."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Abashayeli bakho basebusuku bathini ngamaloli amanzi kamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Abaphathi bakho base-rank bangikweleta ngenxa yokuthula komzila wase-Berea. Susa amapuleti ami kubahloli baka-Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Umanyano lwase-Queen Street luma ndawonye. Ingabe i-rank inganginika imali yokusebenza?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Gcina izibani zakho ziphansi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Lalela ngokucophelela. Lawo maloli anezimpawu ze-City Hall eminyango, akunjalo? Kodwa abafana bami abasebenza e-Umbilo bathi amasondo acindezelwe isisindo samakhemikhali, futhi izigebengu zase-Abasanta zihamba ngezimoto i-Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Ngesikhathi omama bethu e-KwaMashu belayini namabhakede epulasitiki emapayipini omile. UMkhandlu u-Ma-Sibi uthengisa izindawo zakhe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Ulwazi oluhle. Masikhulume ngokunye."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Awukaze ukhohlwe ukuthi umgwaqo usebenza kanjani, Sbu. Kwenziwe. Ama-Quantum ami amathathu asanda kuvala imoto yamakhamera e-SAPS ku-Monty Naicker Road. Unendawo yokuphefumula."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Inhlonipho, Bra Bheki."
"Thatha lokhu esikhwameni sempi yenhlangano yomzila. Thenga udizili, nika umabhalane imali, noma ulungise u-Nandi. Qiniseka nje ukuthi u-Mokoena uyopha ngokuminyanisa imigwaqo yethu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Izoya ngqo ekubhidlizeni umkhumbi wabo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Hawu, heyi. Bheka ukuthi yini le eshaywe wumoya yafika ehhovisi lami. Uyalekwe emsebenzini wakho kuma-Hawks, Sbu—ukuhamba ungena lapha kudinga ukuthi mhlawumbe ufuna ukufa noma unommeli obiza kakhulu."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Iphi uConstable Nandi, futhi iphi ibhukwana lomcwaningi mabhuku kamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ngisahlola nje uhlu lwabantu ababoshiwe, Brigadier. Ingabe kukhona okukukhathazayo ku-N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "I-Internal Affairs ePitoli isivele inekhophi ye-Docket #409. Yeka ukusesha kwakho noma sobabili sizoshiswa."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Nginomsindo wakho utshela abantu ukuthi bayohlasela e-Umgeni, Titus. Ngikhokhele ukuze ngilahle le khophi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Lala kahle, Brigadier. Qaphela lapho uhamba khona ebumnyameni."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "I-Durban ihamba ngokuhleleka, Sbu. UZuko ugcina amadokodo ethule, uMa-Sibi ugcina izibani zivutha eCity Hall, kanti ne-Task Force yami igcina ukuthula. UMandla Sithole wayecabanga ukuthi iphepha elinamanani lingamisa isitimela."
"Nikeza uNandi ngaphambi kwaphakathi kwamabili ngosuku lwesine, noma amadoda ami ngeke azihluphe ngokungqongqoza emnyango wakho e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Bamba lowo mbono, Titus."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Yekani ukulandela imoto yesine neyesikhombisa e-Victoria Embankment. Ubulokhu wazi ukuthi udlalwa kanjani umdlalo wezepolitiki, Sbu. Jabulela amahora angamashumi amabili nane angeziwe—ngeke akusindise uma i-Berth 14 isivuliwe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Ngakho-ke i-Hawk enombono ekugcineni ifunde intengo yenyama eThekwini. Thatha le mali ebanjiwe ekhabetheni. Gcina lelo fayela lomsindo lingafiki edesikini likaColonel van der Merwe, mhlawumbe uZuko angakuvumela uphile uze ubone isonto elizayo."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Sizobona ukuthi isikweletu sakho sihlala isikhathi esingakanani."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Vala umnyango, sithandwa, umswakama uyonakalisa ifenisha yami. Wonke umuntu kuleli dolobha uyakhala uma ugesi wehla uya ku-Stage 6, kodwa akekho obuzayo ukuthi ubani okhokhela lezi zepolitiki."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "Ubulokhu uzulazula e-Procurement Registry B. Ngitshele ukuthi umphenyi oxoshiwe ufuna ukuthini ngengqalasizinda yamanzi ephuthumayo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Kungani i-Sub-Station 14 ihlale icima uma i-Pier 2 ithulula impahla phakathi kwamabili?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Amashumi amane ekhulwini e-Zululand Aqua-Logistics angaphansi kwesikhwama somndeni wakho, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Umfana wakho ushiye uhlelo lwe-Sub-Station 14 kumshini we-fax. Ngikopisha isikhathi sokucima kukagesi ethekwini."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Jabulela i-air-conditioning isekhona, Councillor."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Ukucima kukagesi kuyinhlekelele, Sbu—ngaphandle uma wazi ukuthi yimuphi u-breaker okufanele uwudonse nokuthi nini. Uma i-Stage 6 ishaya i-Point Waterfront, amakhamera e-Transnet ayaba yizimpumputhe amahora amane."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Abangani be-City Hall abahlali ebumnyameni. Izitha zithola izindlu zazo zihlaselwe ngaphambi kokuba izibani zomgwaqo zibuye."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Isivumelwano esikahle."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "UMandla Sithole wayengumcwaningi mabhuku ohlakaniphile kodwa engenalo ikhono lokusinda. Wena, ngakolunye uhlangothi, uyaqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukubamba umuntu ngamandla."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Nansi imali engamakhulu amahlanu amaRand njengesibambiso esivela esikhwameni sesigodi. Gcina igama lesikhwama sami lingaveli emaphephandabeni, futhi ihhovisi lami lingakwazi nokulawula ugesi we-Eskom uma udinga ukuba kube mnyama."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ngizoyifaka ephaketheni le mali. Sizobona ngamaphephandaba."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Abasebenzi abanekhono kunzima ukubathola kulo masipala. Kulungile—thatha leli phepha le-telecoms. Uzothola ukuthi liqonde ngqo kureni kaZuko e-Berth 14 noma kunjalo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Councillor."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Qaphela ucingo olucashile eduze kwesitendi samasambulela, Sbu! Ugesi we-Stage 4 usanda kushisa ama-oscilloscope ami amabili, kanti izigebengu ze-cyber-crime zikaMokoena bezilokhu zihlola wonke umbhoshongo wesignali phakathi kwe-Grey Street ne-harbour."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "Ulethe ifoni kaMandla Sithole? Leyo foni inohlelo lwe-Abasanta olusula yonke into kude kwi-chip."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Yini ekuleyo foni yomcwaningi mabhuku eyenza uZuko noMokoena besabe kangaka?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Masixhume ama-JTAG pins ngaphakathi kwe-Faraday cage ngaphambi kokuba i-baseband ithumele isignali emubhoshongweni."
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Bilisa ikhofi elinamandla bese uhlola ifoni yami yomgunyathi ukuthi ayinazo yini izinto zokulalela ze-SAPS."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Gcina i-Faraday cage ivaliwe, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "USithole wayengeyena nje umcwaningi mabhuku—wafaka imakrofoni efihliwe ngaphakathi e-Pier 2 Cold Storage. Ngaphambi kokuba bashayise imoto yakhe ku-N2, ifoni yakhe yagcina umyalezo wezwi wemizuzwana engamashumi amane nesishiyagalombili kanye nohlu lwempahla ye-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Qaphela ukucima kukagesi kwe-Stage 6, nokho. Ngaphandle uma usebenzisa i-generator yakho, umshini wami wokuvula amakhodi uyacima."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Kuhle ukwazi. Masihlole ibhentshi."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Bheka leyo timing kagesi—sidlule i-lock yokuqala ngaphandle kokuvula uhlelo lokusula lwe-Abasanta. Okunye ukuzama okuhlanzekile ebhentshini futhi le drive ngeyakho."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Ukushisela okuhle, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Yebo, i-Central Precinct ibinombhoshongo wokulalela oxhumene ne-SIM yakho endala. Sengishintshe i-MAC address yakho ukuze ibukeke njengemitha yokupaka kamasipala. Phuza!"
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Lokho kumnandi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Bheka ngaphandle ethekwini, Sbu. Imikhumbi engamashumi ayisithupha ilindile, izinkulungwane ezintathu zamakonteyina ngosuku, kanti iPitoli icabanga ukuthi iphepha elisayinwe yijaji lingalawula leli theku."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ngakhe i-Abasanta Logistics kusukela eshedini elilodwa elibandayo. Manje umi phezu kwendlela yami unebhukwana lomcwaningi mabhuku ofile. Uze lapha ukuzodlala iqhawe, noma uze lapha ukuzoqonda ukuthi ibhizinisi lisebenza kanjani?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "Ubuthisa amanzi elokishini ukuze uthuthe amakhemikhali, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Khombisa Ubufakazi: I-Manifest yase-Berth 14] "Isitsha i-MSCU-908114 siphawuliwe. Ngifake esabelweni se-logistics noma ama-Hawks azohlasela i-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Onogada bakho base-Berth 14 basanda kushintsha amashifu. Sengivele ngiyibonile indawo abangayiboni eduze kwama-valve kaphethiloli."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Sizoyixazulula le nto uma sekuhamba umkhumbi waphakathi kwamabili, Zuko."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "I-City Hall yantshontsha isabelomali samanzi eminyakeni eyishumi ngaphambi kokuba ngiqashe ithanka, Sbu. Ngavele ngaqasha amaloli abo angenalutho. Kuleli zwe, ingqalasizinda ingeyalowo ogcina udizili futhi okhokhela onogada."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "UMokoena uyisigebengu esingacabangi, kanti uMa-Sibi uyisikhwabanisi. Ngisize ukusula i-Berth 14 ebusuku, ngeke usaphinde uzabalazele irenti e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Wonke umphathi wezigebengu ucabanga ukuthi uyisazi sefilosofi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Indoda ehlakaniphile. Ama-Hawks akukhokhele kancane akulahla ezingonyameni lapho ususondele kakhulu eqinisweni. Thatha lokhu njengesabelo sakho sokuqala esivela e-Berth 14. Uma sekungaphakathi kwamabili, qiniseka ukuthi lowo mkhumbi uyahamba."
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Sizobona ukuthi phakathi kwamabili kuletheni."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Akumangalisi ukuthi iqembu likaMokoena likuphuthele ku-N2. Uhamba njengentuthu yasechwebeni. Tshela uTitus ukuthi ngiwakhanselile amaphoyisa akhe asechwebeni ebusuku—uma sizovivinyana, masikwenze lokho ngaphandle kwabantu abangazi lutho."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "Kuze kube phakathi kwamabili e-Berth 14."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "Udlule kumakhamera enkantolo kamantshi, Sbu. Kuhle. Ingxenye yezindlunkulu zesifundazwe isekhokhelweni likaMokoena, yingakho ngithuthele ithimba lami lapha ngezansi nemishini yama-microfiche yama-1980."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "Ubuka sengathi usenkingeni enkulu, mfana wami—futhi ngizwile ukuthi uConstable Nandi udutshuliwe ku-N2. Ngitshele ukuthi ulethe okuthile okungamelana nejaji leNkantolo eNkulu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Kungani ama-Hawks engakabambi uMokoena noMa-Sibi, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Khombisa Ubufakazi: I-Manifest yase-Berth 14] "Lalela le fayela lomsindo, Colonel. UMokoena uyena owala ukuthi kuhlaselwe ku-N2."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Gcina umnyango uvaliwe, Colonel. Sengicishe ngalunga."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ngoba njalo uma ngibhala i-warrant phezulu, othile eMnyangweni uyamtshela uMasipala kungakapheli imizuzu eyishumi nanhlanu. Ngaphandle kwencwadi yezimali KANYE nomsindo wase-Berth 14, umshushisi uzoyichitha icala ngaphambi kwesidlo sasekuseni."
"Uma sithumela lonke iphakethe ngqo egumbini lezindaba le-Daily Veld ngenkathi sivikela uNandi, ngeke bakwazi ukukufihla."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Khona-ke sizodlula phezulu ngokuphelele."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Nkosi yami... 'vimba imoto yakhe ngaphambi kwe-off-ramp yase-Umgeni bese ushisa isikhwama.' Lelo izwi likaTitus Mokoena, lizwakala kahle."
"Ngibeka imoto yakho kurejista yethu yezokuxhumana manje ukuze usule ukushisa kwakho emaphoyiseni. Hlala uphila kuze kube sikhuluma lokhu, Sbu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Ngiyabonga, Colonel."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Umoya uhlanzekile lapha phezulu e-Ridge, akunjalo, Sbu? Ezansi e-CBD babambe umhlangano wabo omncane wokuphenya, bezenza sengathi ijaji elithatha umhlalaphansi lingalungisa iminyaka engamashumi amabili yokukhwabanisa komasipala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Izikhwama zami sezivele zise-King Shaka Hangar 7. Kungani ukhwela umbhoshongo wami wengilazi kanti isiphepho sesicishe saphela?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Iyini i-Sovereign Pearl Holdings, futhi kungani i-Gulfstream igcwaliswe uphethiloli e-Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Umfana wakho wezimali ukhohlwe ukusula i-Dubai SWIFT mirror kuseva yaphansi yesi-28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Khombisa Ubufakazi: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Nginesheduli yabanikazi, Ma-Sibi. Thenga indawo yakho ngaphandle kohlu lwami lwezinsolo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Ungayigibeli leyo Gulfstream okwamanje, Councillor."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Wonke usopolitiki ohlakaniphile e-KwaZulu-Natal uyazi ukuthi i-Rand eyokuchitha kanti i-Dirham eyokugcina. I-Sovereign Pearl inezakhiwo e-Dubai, ipulazi lezithelo e-Midlands, nendiza e-Hangar 7."
"UZuko unamaphesenti angamashumi amane nanhlanu, mina nginamashumi amathathu, kanti uTitus Mokoena unamashumi amabili nanhlanu ngokugcina izibhamu zikude nathi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Ukuhlukana okuhle kwabathathu."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "Uhacke i-terminal ye-escrow? Uyaqhubeka ngempela. Kulungile—abashushisi abaphethe leyo Warrant yokudelela inkantolo abakukhiphele yona balalela mina. Ngizobatshela ukuthi bawubambezele umbiko wakho wokuboshwa."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Isinyathelo esihlakaniphile."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Yithathe. Qondisa intukuthelo yakho elabhorethri kaZuko yase-Midlands noma izigebengu zikaMokoena—yeka owesifazane omdala aye ekhaya lakhe lokuphumula e-Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Sizobona ukuthi ubani ozohamba ngendiza."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Bheka lawa mathanka esiwathathile izolo ebusuku, Sbu! Izindonga ezingamanga ezishiselwe ngaphakathi—zomile njengamathambo engxenyeni yamanzi, kanti kunezinsalela zamakhemikhali emnyombweni ofihliwe."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Abantu basezindaweni ezisenyakatho sebeyikhathele ukulinda amakhomishini eNkantolo eNkulu. Abashayeli bami bayivalele indawo, kanti izinkabi zikaMokoena ezivela kwamanye amaprovinsi zizulazula ezindaweni eziphakeme zikufuna."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Ingabe amathanka aboshiwe abesenawo ama-GPS transponders awo?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "Masikhiphe ama-GPS flash chips e-Lead Tanker #14 manje bese sibeka abantu abazobheka lezo zigebengu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Bamba amasango edepo, Bra Bheki. Siyohlasela emzini wabo."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Wonke! Phakathi kuka-1:00 ekuseni no-4:00 ekuseni, esikhundleni sokupompa amanzi edamini, lawa maloli akhuphukele ku-N3 eya epulazini lezithelo eduze kwase-Howick."
"Hlanganisa leyo datha, Sbu, uzoba nezindawo eziqondile zelabhorethri kaZuko."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Lokho yisixhumanisi esilahlekile phakathi kwechweba nesikhumulo sezindiza."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Nansi i-flash module evela ku-Tanker #14! Futhi ungakhathazeki ngalezo zigebengu eziqashwe e-Joburg—noma iyiphi imoto engajwayelekile engena endaweni esenyakatho izovinjwa ngama-Quantum angamashumi amane ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukulayisha isibhamu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Siyakwamukela kwiKhomishini yophenyo, Sbu. I-Berth 14 yembule konke okwakwenzeka ethekwini, manje leli qembu lezigebengu selilwa nathi ngabameli abagqoke izingubo zikasilika kanye nemiyalelo yokuvalwa komlomo evela ku-State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Okubi kakhulu, sithole imininingwane yendiza evela e-King Shaka International. Indiza i-ZS-900—i-Gulfstream yangasese—igcwaliswe uphethiloli e-Hangar 7 ukuze ikhiphe uZuko, uMa-Sibi, noMokoena ibayise e-Dubai."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "Yini esiyidingayo ukuze simise indiza i-ZS-900 futhi sibaqede unomphela?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Masifake isicelo esiphuthumayo manje ukuze sichithe i-Contempt Warrant futhi sibize amarekhodi e-escrow ase-Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Qhubeka neKhomishini, Colonel. Mina ngiyozingela."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Imiboniso emibili ebalulekile: Okokuqala, i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed evela kuma-penthouse ase-Ridge efakazela ukuthi bobathathu bangabanikazi bale nkampani yezigebengu. Okwesibili, i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry evela emalolini amanzi asenyakatho."
"Vula noma yikuphi kwalokhu ukuze wembule i-Citrus Estate kanye ne-King Shaka Hangar 7—noma uvikele kokubili uma ufuna ukubafaka bonke emaketangeni khona lapho epulatifomu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Kuqondakala kahle, Colonel."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Isicelo esihle kakhulu, Sbu. Lokho kubophe izandla zabashushisi bakaMa-Sibi abakhohlakele amahora angamashumi amane nesishiyagalombili, futhi kuphoqa unobhala wenkampani yase-Ridge ukuthi avule incwadi ye-DIFC."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "Masisebenzise leli thuba."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "Ulandele amaloli amanzi uze ufike phezulu entabeni, Sbu. Kuyamangaza. Iningi lamadoda liyayeka uma lifika kuma-penthouse ase-Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Bheka nxazonke e-Packhouse B. Amawolintshi ase-Valencia kwi-conveyor ephezulu, kanti amaphesenti angamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nesishiyagalolunye e-crystal emsulwa afihlwe emabhokisini angezansi, elinde ukuthunyelwa e-King Shaka Cargo Apron. Futhi umi phakathi nendawo yokuvuna kwami."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "Ubalekela e-Dubai ngendiza i-ZS-900 ebusuku. Ingabe u-Architect uyesaba?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Yonke inombolo yebatch nomzila wamaloli usuvele ukhophiwe kwenye indawo. Yekisa iqembu lakho lezinkabi futhi ukhokhe intela yokuphuma."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Sizobonana epulatifomu e-Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ngiyesaba? Cha, Sbu—ngenza izinguquko. I-Khomishini yophenyo idinga umdlalo, ngakho uMa-Sibi noMokoena bayethuka. Ngenkathi thina, ingqalasizinda esiyakhe lapha ikhiqiza izigidi ezingamashumi amabili zama-Euro ngenyanga."

"Uma ufika e-Hangar 7 ebusuku, uzoba nokukhetha: usibophele uhulumeni ozosithatha indawo ngoLwesibili, ushise le ndawo neqembu likaBra Bheki, noma uthathe izihluthulelo zesihlalo sobukhosi wena ngokwakho."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Sizokwenza lokho kukhetha e-Hangar 7."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Abadubuli base-Gauteng bayayeka. Uzizuzele indawo etafuleni, Sbu. Thatha lokhu e-safe yase-packhouse—futhi ucabange kahle ngaphambi kokuvumela uColonel van der Merwe ukuthi afake ozankosi esikhathini esizayo."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "Sizobonana esikhumulweni sezindiza."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Ekupheleni komzila, Sbu! Injini ze-Gulfstream zishisile, imvume yezokuxhumana ifakiwe, futhi abasebenzi balayisha amabhokisi okugcina."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "Usindile ku-N2, usindile e-Pier 2, futhi usindile eqenjini lami lezinkabi. Khuluma okwakho ngaphambi kokuba izitebhisi zokugibela zihoxiswe!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Uma ukhwela lezo zitebhisi, Titus, uzoba yisigebengu impilo yakho yonke."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Ingxenye yamasajenti akho e-TRT ayikho kuleyo ndiza, Titus. Ngisanda kubatshela ukuthi ubashiya ukuze bathwale umthwalo weKhomishini."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Isikhathi sokuqeda lokhu epulatifomu."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Isigebengu? Ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu e-Sovereign Pearl Holdings e-Dubai, bazongibiza ngokuthi ngingumeluleki wezokuphepha wamazwe ngamazwe! Noma usuke endleleni yamasondo endiza, noma wenze okokugcina lapha!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Iya kuphi i-Unit 3 ne-Unit 5?! Suka lapho, Sbu—uphendule amasajenti ami ngokumelene nami! Wonke umuntu uzilwela yena lapha epulatifomu!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Ipulatifomu ivulekile. Masikuqede lokhu."
